name: Animal Medical Center (AMC / Schwarzman)
aka: AMC (Schwarzman Animal Medical Center, Manhattan) funds
AMC (Schwarzman Animal Medical Center, Manhattan) financial-assistance funds
notes:
510 East 62nd St (between FDR Drive and York Ave), New York, NY 10065. Open 24 hours; New York City's largest specialty and emergency animal hospital. Emergency (212) 838-8100; appointments (212) 838-7053.

Help paying (read on its financial assistance page, 2026-11-10): AMC has its own funds for people who cannot afford treatment there, for any animal: Charlie's Patient Assistance Fund (free or reduced-cost emergency care), the Buddy Fund (cancer), the Monty and Minny Fund (rehabilitation), SAVE (owners 65 and over), the Honey Bunny and Rou Fund (rabbits and German Shepherds), the Kiki White Umbrella Cockatoo Avian Fund (birds), and free care for active guide dogs. An AMC vet must see the animal first, you must live in New York, New Jersey or Connecticut, and the application must reach AMC within 5 business days of treatment starting, so ask as soon as you arrive. Its Client Services Managers can also set up a payment plan for what a fund does not cover. Email funds@amcny.org.
